description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Search e-tax invoice summary (totals). Choose ONE date mode: (1) daily: set date_type='01' and start_date+end_date YYYYMMDD. (2) monthly: set date_type='02' and year+month. (3) quarterly: set date_type='03' and year+quarter. search_type '01'=issued(매출), '02'=received(매입).

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

date_type.description: Date mode: '01'=daily(default, needs start_date/end_date), '02'=monthly(needs year+month), '03'=quarterly(needs year+quarter).

end_date.description: End date YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20250930). Required when date_type='01' (daily).

start_date.description: Start date YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20250701). Required when date_type='01' (daily).

name: hometax__etax__invoice__search_summary
title: 전자세금계산서 합계 조회
